subject: Q4 QBR: Roadmap alignment, timeline stress points, and mitigation lanes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: Q4 QBR: Roadmap alignment, timeline stress points, and mitigation lanes

Team —

As we pull together the Q4 QBR pack for next week, I want a concise, actionable snapshot of where product + eng stand on the three prioritized launches: Hosted API throughput optimizations (v2), Dedicated autoscale controls, and Private deployment packaging (air-gapped). Please see attached qbr_readiness_matrix.xlsx — I populated known dates and a first-pass risk column.

Quick asks (today/EOD):
- Karthik: confirm engineering ETA windows and any scope you think must be cut to hit the Timeline lanes.
- Aditya: call out any outstanding acceptance criteria or open PM tickets blocking release.
- Laura: confirm prioritization for QBR narrative and whether we should surface any of these as exec-level risks.

Key constraints we've flagged so far:
- Infra staffing pressure over Dec -> potential 2-week slip on v2 unless we reallocate a small infra burst.
- Morgan Cloud partner integration still in testing; dependency for Dedicated autoscale.
- Procurement delay from Nimbus could push pilot start from Jan -> Feb.

Attach: qbr_readiness_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet: feature / owner / ETA / top risks)

I'll consolidate responses into a single slide for the leadership packet. If you see an immediate blocker, please DM me and I'll escalate.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR: Roadmap alignment, timeline stress points, and mitigation lanes

Marissa —

Quick status on the three launches (short bullets):
- Hosted API v2 (throughput): Core work is code-complete for kernel swap and batching logic, currently in system tests. ETA: 2027-01-12 for canary rollout if we keep current staffing. Risk: infra perf regression at long seq lengths; mitigation: expand perf test matrix + hold a 48-hour soak.
- Dedicated autoscale controls: control plane changes done; edge-case flapping observed in canary. ETA: 2026-12-30 for rollout with a guarded canary. Risk: partner integration with Morgan Cloud (edge routing) — they must finish their shim.
- Private (air-gapped) packaging: packaging scripts done, but validation harness needs additional test vectors. ETA: 2027-01-20 if we get a 1-2 week packaging surge. Risk: resource contention; mitigation: propose temporary reallocation of two infra engineers from maintenance to packaging for the first half of Jan.

I've attached the launch-risk-register.csv with current top-level risks and owners. Short ask: can we approve the engineering surge (2 FTE infra) as a QBR contingency? That buys the timelines above.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Engineering — Serving Runtime
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: launch-risk-register.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR: Roadmap alignment, timeline stress points, and mitigation lanes

Thanks Karthik — good clarity. Couple notes / asks for the QBR narrative: 

- Prioritization: we should surface Hosted API v2 as a revenue-protecting launch (latency/cost improvements) and list Dedicated autoscale as a reliability play with partner dependency. Private (air-gapped) is strategic for enterprise but lower near-term revenue — flag as programmatic.
- Dependencies: Morgan Cloud partner status needs an owner on our side; Marissa, can you own the partner coordination and ask Morgan for a firm completion date?
- Acceptance criteria: Aditya / Product owners, please confirm the minimal acceptance criteria we can commit to in the QBR slide (i.e., performance targets for v2, success metric for autoscale).

Small editorial: avoid wording like "slip" in the executive slide — use "risk window" with mitigations.

On the staffing ask — I support the temporary 2 FTE allocation if leadership signs off; it should be a time-boxed burst with a clear handback plan.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Dana Park <dana.park@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Analytics <procurement@nimbus-analytics.com>, Morgan Cloud Solutions <partner@morgancloud.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T18:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR: Roadmap alignment, timeline stress points, and mitigation lanes

Hi Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the clear status. From Nimbus's side: procurement is working the SOW redlines but we still expect a potential 3-week delay unless we expedite approvals internally. That said, Nimbus can run an early pilot in late Jan if Redwood can give a frozen demo bundle by 2027-01-15.

Two asks from us:
1) Can Redwood provide a sandbox demo package for our security team (air-gapped friendly) by Jan 15?
2) Can we schedule a technical readout with Morgan Cloud and your infra team next week to verify the integration shim?

If we can get the demo bundle and the integration readout scheduled, we can likely keep the pilot in Jan. Otherwise we push to Feb.

I'll make procurement the follow-up owner and loop in our engineering lead if needed.

Best,
Dana Park
Senior Solutions Architect
Nimbus Analytics
dana.park@nimbus-analytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Park <dana.park@nimbus-analytics.com>, Nimbus Analytics <procurement@nimbus-analytics.com>, Morgan Cloud Solutions <partner@morgancloud.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T16:43:00Z
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR: Roadmap alignment, timeline stress points, and mitigation lanes — consolidated plan

Team & Dana —

Thanks for the quick turn. Consolidated plan / next steps for the QBR slide and immediate execution: 

1) Staffing contingency: Karthik -> request to leadership for a temporary 2-FTE infra surge (Jan 3–14). Vivek, marking this for your ok; if approved, Eng to schedule surge and handback.
2) Demo bundle for Nimbus: Aditya + Infra -> produce sandbox demo (air-gapped packaging) by 2027-01-15. Aditya, please confirm the checklist items required by Nimbus security and we will surface in the pack.
3) Morgan integration readout: Karthik to coordinate with Morgan Cloud; target meeting next week (Dec 28). Dana, I'll send a calendar invite once Karthik proposes times.
4) QBR narrative: Laura to craft the executive framing (risk window + mitigations) — I will provide her the updated matrix and Karthik's risk register by EOD tomorrow.

Deliverables & owners (for slide):
- Readiness matrix (Marissa) — v1 consolidated by 2026-12-22 18:00Z
- Risk register (Karthik) — current owners and mitigations by 2026-12-22 18:00Z
- Exec slide (Laura) — draft by 2026-12-23 12:00Z
- Leadership ask (Vivek) — approval for 2-FTE contingency by 2026-12-23 18:00Z

Attachments: qbr_readiness_matrix.xlsx, launch-risk-register.csv
Links: https://docs.redwood.com/qbr/2026/roadmap-matrix | HubSpot:HB-5543

I'll update the QBR slide deck once we have Karthik's risk register and Aditya's sandbox checklist. If anyone needs a separate sync, I'm available this afternoon.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
